service.en: To Whom It May Concern certificate

about: Get a letter confirming property ownership or compliance with property management rules.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. To Whom It May Concern certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: No documents through the app or website
Emirates ID at a trustee centre, plus a passport for non-residents
fees: AED 50 per letter plus AED 10 knowledge and AED 10 innovation fees
AED 50 plus VAT extra at a trustee centre
Free for People of Determination and AED 70 for senior citizens via call centre
channels: DLD call centre for People of Determination and senior citizens
